description_localkey: A mad scientist who believes that science is the domain of humankind. She can often be seen carrying out all manner of experiments and overseeing the lives of her fellow M.M.R. members.

element_details.element_desc_localekey: Injects Code: Z.E.U.S. to all water-type enemies, dealing 10% additional damage.

piece_detail.description_localkey:
Used for a Nikke's Limit Break.
Spare Bodies for a fully enhanced Nikke will be converted into Body Labels.

shot_detail.description_localkey:
■ Affects target(s).
<color=#00AEFF>Deals {damage}% of ATK as damage.
Deals {core_damage_rate}% damage when attacking core.</color>

skill2_detail.description_localkey:
■ Affects the {description_value_01} enemy unit(s) with the highest <word_group=10025>final</word_group> DEF.
<color=#00AEFF>Deals {description_value_02}% of <word_group=10025>final</word_group> ATK as damage.</color>

<color=#00AEFF>DEF ▼ {description_value_03}% for {description_value_04} sec.</color>

skill1_detail.description_localkey:
■ Affects {description_value_01} allies with the lowest remaining HP. 
<color=#00AEFF>Damage Taken ▼ {description_value_02}% for {description_value_03} sec.</color>

ulti_skill_detail.description_localkey:
■ Affects the {description_value_01} ally unit(s) with the lowest remaining HP.
<color=#00AEFF>Creates a <word_group=10023>shield</word_group> with HP equal to {description_value_02}% of the the skill user's <word_group=10025>final</word_group> max HP that lasts for {description_value_03} sec.</color>

squad_detail.squad_description: The Central Government's Ark weapon research unit, which utilizes Missilis technology. Its formal name is the Missilis Military Research Center, or M.M.R. for short.

character_dialog_group_list.speech_localkey: What is our experiment for today, No. 7?
How's the medicine? No bleeding, I hope?
Now be good and take your medicine.
I can't wait to conduct our experiment together, No. 7.
So you're feeling fine? Too bad, I can't look after you in that case.
If you ever get sick, don't take any medicine. Just come and find me and I'll make some for you.
Is that all? I should be going then.
We don't have to do anything special. I just enjoy watching you.
Don't mind the smell. Everything's fine in the library.

Any wild animals around here?
I'm cooking up a great experiment.
Come to the library if you want some supplements.
This shot will make you stronger.
Some enhancements here... and then... perfect.
Well, I'm an intellectual after all...
I'm stronger now, although that may spell trouble for me.
That's good, but... what's up with you?
How am I supposed to take it back? Well, thanks anyway.
It's only a gift, right?
Take care of yourself, my precious No. 7.
It's amazing... the more I observe you, the more intriguing you become.
No. 7, you can never ever leave me. Got it?
Combat is not my strong suit...
Do I really have to?
Sure, why not?
I suppose this can help me vent.
Oh yes, you'll make for wonderful guinea pigs.
Perfect for my experiment.
Ready to meet your demise?
Reloading.
Why does this always have to happen to me?
One moment, I'll be right back.
I know what I have to do next.
There's no need to be afraid. This is good for you.
You're wasting my time. Let's get this over with.
Nice.
Good shot.
Broken?
Damn.
Agh.
Uh.
This is why I detest fighting.
This experiment was a great success. Now, who's next?
